main.name: Elemental HERO Stratos
summary: When it's Normal or Special Summoned, pick one: destroy Spells/Traps up to the number of other HEROs you control, or add a HERO from your Deck to your hand.
notes: Your best Normal Summon. Search Faris if you have a HERO to discard, otherwise Shadow Mist.
Your main non-DARK HERO. Tribute Faris for Increase and keep Stratos to pair with Increase for Sunrise.
A Hero Lives can summon it from the Deck, and its search still triggers.
Going second, the backrow destroy mode can clear a floodgate if you control other HEROs.

main.name: Elemental HERO Shadow Mist
summary: If Special Summoned: add a “Change” Quick-Play Spell from your Deck.
If sent to the GY: add a HERO from your Deck, except Shadow Mist.
You can only use one of these effects per turn, and only once.
notes: The best Faris discard and Vyon dump: it searches from the GY, which Imperm can't touch.
Only one Shadow Mist effect per turn across all copies. If one already searched, a second dumped Shadow Mist won't.
Great way to stage Neos: search it so Favorite Contact can make Shining Neos Wingman.
DARK Elemental HERO, so it pairs with a LIGHT one for Miracle Fusion into Infernal Rage.
With no Change spells in the deck, its Special Summon effect has nothing to grab, so the GY search stays available that turn.

main.name: Vision HERO Faris
summary: Discard another HERO to Special Summon it from your hand.
When Normal or Special Summoned: place a Vision HERO (not Faris) from your Deck face-up in your backrow as a Continuous Trap. You can only summon HEROs from the Extra Deck for the rest of the turn.
Each effect once per turn.
notes: Always place Increase. That's the whole engine.
Placing isn't adding, summoning, or sending, so Ash can't stop it. Imperm on Faris can.
It's Level 5, so a Normal Summon needs a Tribute. After A Hero Lives, you can tribute the Stratos it summoned.
DARK, like Vyon and Increase. Tribute Faris, not Stratos, to summon Increase.

main.name: Vision HERO Vyon
summary: When Normal or Special Summoned: send a HERO from your Deck to the GY (once per turn).
Once per turn: banish a HERO from your GY to add Polymerization from your Deck.
notes: Usually comes from Increase, so it doesn't use your Normal Summon.
Keep it on the field instead of using it as material. Its Polymerization search works again every turn while it's out.
Dump Shadow Mist for a search (often Stratos as your non-DARK HERO), or Neos to turn on Instant Contact.
Don't banish the Shadow Mist or Neos you still need for Miracle Fusion or Favorite Contact.

main.name: Vision HERO Increase
summary: If you take battle or effect damage while it's in your GY: place it in your backrow as a Continuous Trap.
During the Main Phase while it's a Continuous Trap: Tribute a HERO to Special Summon it.
When Special Summoned from the backrow: Special Summon a Level 4 or lower Vision HERO from your Deck.
Each effect once per turn.
notes: Run 2 so Faris always has one left in the Deck.
Use it as Fusion material instead of Vyon. In the GY, it returns to your backrow when you take damage, and next turn you tribute Vyon to restart the engine.
A copy in hand is perfect Faris discard fodder.
Going first with no starter, set it. If it's destroyed and you take damage, it returns to your backrow ready to go.

main.name: Destiny HERO - Malicious
summary: Banish it from your GY to Special Summon another Malicious from your Deck.
notes: Level 6 HERO + Destiny HERO: two copies from Deck make Destroyer Phoenix Enforcer with Fusion Destiny.
The best Faris discard when you don't need Shadow Mist's search.
Its GY summon is good Ash bait.

main.name: Elemental HERO Neos
summary: No effect.
notes: Instant Contact needs it on your field or in your GY.
Material for Shining Neos Wingman, from hand, field, GY, or banished through Favorite Contact.
Making Infernal Rage with Neos turns on Infernal Rage's tribute effect.

main.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
summary: Discard it when your opponent activates an effect that adds from the Deck, summons from the Deck, or sends from the Deck to the GY: negate that effect. Once per turn.
notes: Save it for their starter's search or Deck summon, not a random extender.
Check the Checkpoints tab for where theirs hits you.

main.name: Maxx "C"
summary: Quick Effect: send it from your hand to the GY. For the rest of the turn, draw a card each time your opponent Special Summons.
You can only use 1 Maxx “C” per turn.
notes: Best on their first turn going second, as soon as they start special summoning.

main.name: Mulcharmy Fuwalos
summary: Quick Effect, if you control no cards: discard it. For the rest of the turn, draw a card each time your opponent Special Summons from the Deck or Extra Deck.
At that End Phase, if your hand has more cards than (cards your opponent controls + 6), you randomly shuffle the extra cards back into the Deck.
You can only activate 1 other Mulcharmy effect the turn you use it.
notes: A going-second card. Going first, you'll control cards after your combo, so it's dead that turn.
Chain it to their first Deck or Extra Deck summon. Summons from hand or GY draw you nothing.
The bigger their board, the more cards you keep, so it punishes them for comboing hard.

main.name: A Hero Lives
summary: If you control no face-up monsters: pay half your LP to Special Summon a Level 4 or lower Elemental HERO from your Deck.
notes: Play it before anything face-up hits the field. A face-down Set monster (like a Set Increase) doesn't stop it.
Usually summons Stratos, which still searches. Your Normal Summon stays open.

main.name: Fusion Destiny
summary: Fusion Summon a Fusion Monster that lists a Destiny HERO as material, using monsters from your hand or Deck. It's destroyed during the End Phase of the next turn.
After it resolves, you can only Special Summon DARK HEROs for the rest of the turn.
Only 1 Fusion Destiny per turn.
notes: Malicious + Malicious from Deck makes Destroyer Phoenix Enforcer.
Play it last, after your Sunrise, Infernal Rage, and Shining Neos Wingman.
Using Deck materials makes it Ash-able, so protect it.

main.name: E - Emergency Call
summary: Add an Elemental HERO from your Deck to your hand.
notes: Usually grabs Stratos. Grab Shadow Mist or Neos when you need them.
Lead with it to bait Ash.

main.name: Polymerization
summary: Fusion Summon using monsters from your hand or field as material.
notes: Vyon searches it.
Wonder Driver can Set a used copy back from the GY.

main.name: Instant Contact
summary: Pay 1000 LP: Special Summon a Level 7 or lower Elemental HERO or Neo-Spacian from your Extra Deck, ignoring its summoning conditions.
If Neos isn't on your field or in your GY, that monster can't attack, has its effects negated, and returns at the End Phase. One per turn.
notes: Get Neos into the GY first.
Flame Wingman for Shining Neos Wingman, or Sunrise for its Miracle Fusion search.
Even negated, the monster is still a HERO body for tributes and materials.

main.name: Miracle Fusion
summary: Fusion Summon an Elemental HERO Fusion Monster by banishing materials from your field or GY.
notes: Sunrise searches it, so one copy is enough.
Shadow Mist (DARK) + Stratos (WIND) or Neos (LIGHT) into Infernal Rage. Both materials must be Elemental HEROs with different Attributes.

main.name: Favorite Contact
summary: Special Summon a Fusion Monster that lists a HERO as material, ignoring its summoning conditions, by putting its listed materials from your hand, field, GY, or banished cards on the bottom of the Deck. One per turn.
notes: Infernal Rage searches it. Set it for their turn.
Flip it mid-combo on their turn for Shining Neos Wingman after they commit monsters. Neos must be in your hand, field, GY, or banished, not the Deck.
Not only for Shining Neos Wingman: it can make any Fusion that lists a HERO, like DPE from two Malicious in your GY or banished.

main.name: Infinite Impermanence
summary: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls: negate its effects until the end of the turn.
If it was Set before activation, other Spell/Trap effects in its column are also negated for the rest of the turn.
If you control no cards, you can activate it from your hand.
notes: Going first: set it, since you'll control cards after your combo.
Going second: activate it from your hand on their first turn.
Best targets: a monster about to make their big play, or a negater like Baronne de Fleur or Photon Lord.
It can't stop effects that start in the hand or GY.

extra.name: Destiny HERO - Destroyer Phoenix Enforcer
summary: Materials: a Level 6 or higher HERO + a Destiny HERO.
Your opponent's monsters lose 200 ATK for each HERO card in your GY.
Quick Effect: destroy 1 card you control and 1 card on the field.
If destroyed: during the next Standby Phase, Special Summon a Destiny HERO from your GY.
Each effect once per turn.
notes: Your best end board. Save the Quick Effect for their turn.
Going second, pop their negater at the start of your Main Phase.
extra.when: Going first as your end board, or at the start of your turn going second.
extra.why: Quick Effect: destroy 1 of your cards and 1 card on the field. Comes back with a Destiny HERO from the GY if destroyed.

extra.name: Elemental HERO Shining Neos Wingman
summary: Materials: Neos + a Wingman Fusion Monster. Must be Fusion Summoned.
Gains 300 ATK for each monster in your GY and can't be destroyed by card effects.
When Special Summoned: destroy your opponent's cards up to the number of different Attributes on the field (once per turn).
Burns for a destroyed monster's original ATK when it wins a battle.
notes: Favorite Contact on their turn, or Polymerization going second.
More Attributes on the field means more destruction.
extra.when: On their turn through Favorite Contact, or on your turn with Polymerization before attacking.
extra.why: Destroys their cards up to the number of different Attributes on the field. Can't be destroyed by card effects.

extra.name: Elemental HERO Flame Wingman - Infernal Rage
summary: Materials: 2 Elemental HEROs with different Attributes.
When Special Summoned: add a “Favorite” card from your Deck or GY.
If made with a Normal Monster: Tribute it to Special Summon a Level 7 or lower Elemental HERO that can't be Normal Summoned from your Deck or Extra Deck.
Each effect once per turn.
notes: Make it to search Favorite Contact.
It counts as a Wingman for Shining Neos Wingman.
extra.when: Whenever you can make it, mainly to search Favorite Contact.
extra.why: Counts as a Wingman. If made with Neos (a Normal Monster), it can tribute itself to summon a Level 7 or lower Elemental HERO that can't be Normal Summoned from your Deck or Extra Deck, like Sunrise or Flame Wingman.

extra.name: Elemental HERO Sunrise
summary: Materials: 2 HEROs with different Attributes.
Your monsters gain 200 ATK for each different Attribute you control.
When Special Summoned: add Miracle Fusion from your Deck.
When another of your HEROs is involved in an attack: destroy a card on the field.
notes: Your easiest Fusion and your bridge to Infernal Rage.
Attack with a smaller HERO first to trigger its destroy.
extra.when: Early in the combo when Polymerization is your only Fusion, or going second against one key card.
extra.why: Searches Miracle Fusion. Destroys a card when another of your HEROs attacks.

extra.name: Elemental HERO Flame Wingman
extra.materials: Instant Contact target (Level 6). Its real materials are Avian + Burstinatrix.
summary: Materials: Elemental HERO Avian + Elemental HERO Burstinatrix (not in this deck). Must be Fusion Summoned and can't be Special Summoned any other way, but Instant Contact and Favorite Contact ignore that.
When it destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the GY: burn for that monster's ATK.
notes: Instant Contact target once Neos is in place.
A Wingman for Shining Neos Wingman without spending a Fusion spell.
extra.when: Once Neos is on your field or in your GY.
extra.why: A Wingman for Shining Neos Wingman without spending a Fusion spell.

extra.name: Destiny HERO - Dangerous
summary: Materials: a Destiny HERO + a DARK Effect Monster.
Quick Effect: discard a card to send a Destiny HERO from your hand or Deck to the GY. Your Destiny HEROs gain 200 ATK for each Destiny HERO in your GY this turn. Once per turn.
notes: Fusion Destiny can make it from two Malicious.
Its ATK boost turns on Dystopia's destroy.
extra.when: From Fusion Destiny next to DPE, or with Dystopia going second.
extra.why: Quick Effect: discard to dump a Destiny HERO and pump your Destiny HEROs. Turns on Dystopia's destroy.

extra.name: Destiny HERO - Dystopia
summary: Materials: 2 Destiny HEROs.
When Special Summoned: burn for the ATK of a Level 4 or lower Destiny HERO in your GY.
Quick Effect, if its ATK differs from its original: destroy a card on the field and reset its ATK.
Each effect once per turn.
notes: Pair with Dangerous to change its ATK.
Its burn needs a Level 4 or lower Destiny HERO in your GY. With Denier cut, you usually won't have one, so treat it as a 2800 body with a destroy.
extra.when: Going second for an extra destroy once Dangerous changes its ATK. Its burn needs a Level 4 or lower Destiny HERO, which this deck no longer runs.
extra.why: Burns for a Level 4 or lower Destiny HERO's ATK. Destroys a card once its ATK has changed.

extra.name: Vision HERO Trinity
summary: Materials: 3 HEROs.
When Fusion Summoned, its ATK doubles to 5000 for the turn.
Can attack 3 times per Battle Phase, but can't attack directly.
notes: Going second against 2 or 3 monsters you can beat.
extra.when: Going second against 2 or 3 monsters you can beat.
extra.why: Double ATK on Fusion Summon and 3 attacks. It can't attack directly.

extra.name: Xtra HERO Cross Crusader
summary: Materials: 2 Warrior monsters.
When Link Summoned: Special Summon a Destiny HERO from your GY.
Tribute a Destiny HERO: add a HERO with a different name from your Deck.
Each effect once per turn. Only HERO special summons the turn you use either.
notes: Turns 2 spare bodies into Malicious plus a fresh search when your combo stalls.
extra.when: When the combo stalls with 2 spare Warriors and a Destiny HERO in the GY.
extra.why: Revives a Destiny HERO, then tributes one to search a HERO. HERO-only lock.

extra.name: Xtra HERO Wonder Driver
summary: Materials: 2 HEROs.
When a HERO is Normal or Special Summoned to a zone it points to: Set a Polymerization, Fusion, or Change spell from your GY. Once per turn.
If it's destroyed by battle, or by an opponent's card effect, and sent to the GY: Special Summon a HERO from your hand.
notes: Turns one Polymerization into two.
If they destroy it, it replaces itself with a HERO from your hand.
extra.when: After using Polymerization when more HERO summons are coming.
extra.why: Sets a used Polymerization or a spell with “Fusion” in its name (Miracle Fusion, Fusion Destiny) from your GY when a HERO lands in a zone it points to.

extra.name: Xtra HERO Infernal Devicer
summary: Materials: 2 HEROs.
When Link Summoned: reveal a HERO Fusion and add up to 2 of its named materials with different names from your Deck. Only HERO special summons that turn. Once per turn.
Fiend monsters it points to gain ATK/DEF equal to their Level x 100.
notes: Reveal Shining Neos Wingman to add Neos.
Your weakest Extra Deck card. First cut when you get Dark Law back.
extra.when: Only when you need Neos in hand and have 2 spare HEROs.
extra.why: Reveal Shining Neos Wingman to add Neos. Your weakest pick; first cut for Dark Law.
